text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing with North 
Flight, we spotted a stylish little cafe 
and stopped by for a break.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The decor at the entrance was so stylish 
that I've been curious about it for a 
while. I'm so glad I could come with you, 
Trainer!

"It must have opened recently. It's the 
kind of shop that leaves you feeling 
refreshed, like slipping on a brand-new 
shirt."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The interior is wonderful too. It's so 
sophisticated, I'm learning a lot♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Setting the shop's atmosphere is also 
part of styling, after all.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It is clear how much care went into 
everything, from the wallpaper patterns 
and lighting design, down to the color 
scheme of the furniture and material of 
the cutlery.

When asked what points caught her eye, 
North Flight happily explained in detail.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The concept is a casual European-style 
cafe. A relaxed space to unwind without 
any dress code.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The greenery and natural oak flooring are 
distinct, but unifying the lighting in 
warm tones creates such a soothing 
atmosphere, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The cutlery everyone else is using has 
pale pink and green handles, matching the 
colors of the tables and dishware 
perfectly!

After talking with North Flight, I 
naturally developed an interest in fashion 
and found myself visiting clothing stores 
more often, but...

Even when looking at the exact same thing, 
there's a world of difference in the 
amount of information perceived. It made 
me painfully aware of how much further I 
have to go...
choice_data_list:
I wonder if observation is key to honing 
your sense of style

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You're right... Not just in fashion, but 
learning through observation is very 
important.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Still, fashion is meant to be enjoyed. 
It's not something you should stress 
yourself out over♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... To tell the truth, lately I've 
been thinking that you've been sparkling 
even more than before, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You're working so hard, aren't you? That 
dedication of yours is truly wonderful♪
choice_data_list: Thank you, that makes me happy.

text_block_list.text:
However, as North Flight's Trainer, I want 
to refine my fashion sense even more.

"At this point, might as well. Let me take 
the plunge and ask just for reference."
choice_data_list: How do you hone your sense of style?
How do you hone your sense of style?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I see. Now that you ask me 
outright, what could it be...?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I always make sure to visit places 
that make my heart flutter on my days off♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Whether it's an online article, a train 
ad, or just a random moment during a walk, 
don't you ever come across things that 
make you think, 'Hey, this looks nice'?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Then, I take notes like this and visit 
them whenever I have free time.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
And here's a quick tip♪ When you go out, 
try taking just a moment to think about 
what made your heart flutter.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You can see the coordinator's intent 
behind the colors and shapes. It really 
deepens your appreciation♪

text_block_list.name: Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting. Here is your hot 
honey black tea and Americano.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Fufu, thank you very much♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
That's pretty much what I keep in mind. 
You should definitely give it a try too, 
Trainer♪

Take this coffee cup I was served, for 
instance. I pick it up without a second 
thought, but I wonder if there's a special 
dedication put into this as well?

The shape of the cup, its pattern, the 
texture against the lips... Every single 
detail I had taken for granted was 
something chosen by someone—

"When I think about that, ordinary days 
feel special. The warmth in my chest right 
now isn't just from this steaming cup of 
coffee."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, looks like you've gotten the hang of 
something!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
We have plenty of time, so why don't we go 
somewhere? I'd love to know what kind of 
places make your heart race, Trainer!

Since the opportunity presented itself, I 
decided to take them up on it. As for 
places I'd like to go right now...
choice_data_list: Maybe a park with a nice view?
Like a tableware shop or something...

text_block_list.text:
"When I opened Umatter this morning, I saw 
a post about seasonal flowers in bloom. It 
might be nice to take it easy and admire 
the scenery."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Sounds lovely! I'd love to see the 
seasonal flowers too! Shall we head out 
once we finish drinking? ♪

Colorful flowers bloomed in full glory at 
the park. It was far more spectacular than 
what I saw on Umatter, with the soothing 
scent of wind and nectar.

I took photos while discussing what was 
lovely and what clever touches were used 
with North Flight. I thought to myself 
that I would treasure this excitement—

It might be simple-minded of me, but 
listening to North Flight made me want to 
get particular about tableware. I feel 
like I could pick out something great 
right now.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, they do say strike while the iron is 
hot! Shall we go once we finish our 
drinks?♪

North Flight suggested starting with a 
mug, so the two of us looked for something 
that could be used for work.

And so, I purchased the one that caught my 
eye. My heart fluttered at the thought of 
having this mug at work starting tomorrow.
